channel.title: Fred Xu
channel.description: Fred Xu's personal website: essays on philosophy, AI and film, and research in machine learning.

item.title: The Ontology of Love
item.description: What is this thing, love, that it binds two creatures to each other in life and in death? More fundamentally, what is being-in-love, and how is it related to being-in-the-world?

item.title: The Hermeneutics of Samurai Culture in Film and Television
item.description: Before my first boxing match I read Hagakure. Reading it again through Kurosawa, Kobayashi, Mishima, Jarmusch and Samurai Champloo, I find in the samurai ideal a modern invention and a masculine death drive, and in the best films its undoing.

item.title: Kwaidan: Strange Tales of Nature and War
item.description: Masaki Kobayashi's Kwaidan is usually filed under horror. Seen on a big screen, its four ghost stories read better as mysteries: about a nature full of spirits, and about the dead of a lost war.

item.title: The Virtue of Friction
item.description: Some friction only wastes our time, and some is how understanding is built and how hard work becomes absorbing. On learning, skill and flow when a machine can do the work.

item.title: The Philosophy of Boxing
item.description: Why would anyone choose to be hit in the head? Freud's death drive, Musashi's sword after the wars, and what boxing taught me about discipline, fear and flow.

item.title: Reflection on my First Boxing Bout - A Warrior's Journey
item.description: What I learned from losing my first boxing match: sacrifice, the question of why, a sunrise on a trail, and fighting as a spiritual practice.

item.title: Jim Simons, A Tribute
item.description: A tribute to Jim Simons, mathematician, codebreaker, investor and patron of science, and an inspiration of mine: on beauty, usefulness and what wealth can do for curiosity.

item.title: Coffee Shop Reflections
item.description: Why I work best among strangers in a coffee shop, and whether the Paris café of Hemingway and the existentialists is a tradition or a fantasy sold by the cup.
